title: Atari
description: The white stone has one liberty left. Capture it.

solution.comment: Filling the last liberty captures the stone.
That point is already a black stone — look for the empty liberty.

title: Two in a row
description: Two white stones share their last liberty. Capture them.

solution.comment: Both stones share the same final liberty — one move takes both.

title: Bent three
description: Three white stones form an L. One move captures all of them.

solution.comment: The whole shape shares a single liberty at the bottom.
That doesn't touch the white group's liberty.

title: Pinned to the edge
description: A white stone is sitting on the top edge with one breath of air. End it.

solution.comment: The edge removes one liberty for free. Close the last.
Diagonal stones don't take liberties. The straight neighbor does.

title: Cornered
description: Trap the white stone in the corner.

solution.comment: Corner stones have only two liberties — close the last.

title: From above
description: Two white stones, this time captured from the top.

solution.comment: Always look for the shared liberty — direction doesn't matter.

title: Wall capture
description: A row of four white stones — one liberty remains.

solution.comment: Long groups can still share one liberty. Find the open end.
That point is already filled — scan the white group for an empty neighbor.

title: Corner trap
description: Two white stones cling to the corner. End them.

solution.comment: The corner gives stones fewer liberties to begin with.
